title: `push_down_filter` substitutes the wrong expression when `col` and `CAST(col AS ...)` share a schema name (HAVING and correlated IN give type errors)
body:
### Describe the bug

`CAST(t.a AS ...)` has the same schema name as `t.a` (see #26221). `push_down_filter` rewrites a predicate it moves below a node by looking up the node's outputs by name, in a `HashMap`. When the node has both `t.a` and `CAST(t.a AS ...)`, one entry overwrites the other, and the pushed predicate refers to the wrong one. The result is an execution-time type error for a valid query. title: Sort-merge semi/anti/mark joins fail on timezone-aware timestamp, Dictionary, Decimal256 and Time keys: "Unsupported data type in sort merge join comparator"
body:
### Describe the bug

Sort-merge semi / anti / mark joins (`EXISTS`, `IN`, `NOT EXISTS`, ...) fail on several common join key types once a key group reaches the end of an input batch:

```
This feature is not implemented: Unsupported data type in sort merge join comparator: Timestamp(µs, "UTC")
```

Affected key types include timezone-aware timestamps (`Timestamp(_, Some(tz))`, e.g. Parquet timestamps with `isAdjustedToUTC=true`), `Dictionary` (e.g. Hive partition columns), `Decimal256`, and `Time32` / `Time64`. title: DataFrame::fill_null and fill_nan fail on column names with uppercase letters or dots
body:
### Describe the bug

`DataFrame::fill_null` and `DataFrame::fill_nan` fail with a schema error on any DataFrame that has a column whose name is not a plain lowercase identifier, such as `Name` or `a.b`. This happens even when that column is not in the `columns` list being filled.

`fill_columns` rebuilds every column in the projection with `col(field.name())`. `col` parses its argument as a SQL identifier, so `Name` is normalized to `name`, and `a.b` becomes column `b` qualified by table `a`. Neither resolves against the schema.

title: Estimate equality to a scalar subquery without a blanket 20% fallback
body:
## Describe the bug

Replacing a month-key literal with an equivalent scalar subquery changes the
filter estimate from 31 to 14,610 rows. Both return the same 29 rows.

## To Reproduce

From the repository root, with
[PR #25570](https://github.com/apache/datafusion/pull/25570) applied:

```sh
cargo build --profile ci --locked -p datafusion-benchmarks --bin dfbench
repro_dir=$(mktemp -d)
mkdir -p "$repro_dir/data"
curl --fail --location \
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apache/datafusion-benchmarks/32f67477f692453616d2fa98a05a37c5eb4cae49/tpcds/data/sf1/date_dim.parquet \
